items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 16 at 5:17PM EST until November 22 at 7:00AM EST by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 kt and seas 5 to 8 ft.

* WHERE...Edisto Beach to Savannah out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
